evidence.description: REQ-GAS-002's ordering requirement ('no quote, no identity-independent action beyond the kill-switch check' when recipient is missing/malformed) is correctly implemented: is_valid_evm_address(recipient) is checked immediately after the kill-switch check and strictly before resolve_secret/derive_pubkey/any network call, in both dry-run and --live (no live-only branch around this check).

REQ-GAS-003's caps are genuinely separate literals (GAS_PER_INVOCATION_USD_CAP=3.00, GAS_RESERVE_USD=3.00, GAS_MAX_FEE_PCT=12.0), never derived from or sharing state with the USDC-mode constants; select_refill_amount/evaluate_relay_fee are called with these literals explicitly passed, not defaulted.

REQ-GAS-004's named edge case 'relay quote response is missing/malformed details.currencyOut.amount: refuse BEFORE signing/broadcasting' is genuinely covered by test_gas_quote_missing_currency_out_amount_wei_refuses_before_signing, which asserts build_sign_submit is never called and the ledger row is 'skipped'.

evaluate_native_delivery's 10 boundary tests (full delivery, exactly-85%, just-under-85%, zero-delta, negative-delta, unrelated-small-inflow, non-int, bool, default-pct) are genuine distinct fixtures, not a reused happy-path -- but none of the 10 cases sets expected_wei to 0 or a negative value, missing the case this review's FIND-002 identifies.

Caps/fee-cap ordering manually traced end-to-end for run_gas_refill: select_refill_amount (REQ-GAS-003 amount cap) at line 650 and evaluate_relay_fee (REQ-GAS-003 fee cap, gas-mode literal GAS_MAX_FEE_PCT=12.0 explicitly passed) at line 726 are BOTH evaluated and allowed before build_sign_submit is ever called at line 780 -- no code path reaches signing without both caps having passed. Confirmed no accidental sharing with USDC-mode's MAX_FEE_PCT=8.0 default (evaluate_relay_fee's own default parameter is never relied upon in the gas path).

No wei/decimal unit confusion found: amount_units (source leg, Solana USDC) is computed as int(round(amount * 1e6)) -- correct 6-decimal USDC scaling, explicitly commented 'source leg is still Solana USDC (6 decimals)'; expected_wei (destination leg, native ETH) is taken directly from _extract_quote_raw_units's int(raw) with NO additional *1e18/1e6 scaling applied anywhere -- correct, since relay.link's documented amount field is already the raw base-unit (wei) string, and eth_get_balance/evaluate_native_delivery consistently operate on raw wei ints throughout.

Secret safety re-confirmed for the new run_gas_refill path: both derive_pubkey and build_sign_submit exception handlers route through the same sanitized_secret_error(context, exc) helper (never str(exc)) already established for run_refill -- no raw exception interpolation reintroduced. Directly matched against tests/test_franklin_gas_eth_refill.py:165-190 (test_gas_derive_pubkey_decode_failure_ledger_row_never_contains_secret, test_gas_build_sign_submit_decode_failure_never_leaks_secret), which inject a real FAKE_SECRET through the raising path and assert its absence from json.dumps(result) and every ledger row -- genuine failing-path injections, not tautological.

Test-file organization follows the many-small-files convention as claimed: the new gas-eth orchestration suite is a separate file (test_franklin_gas_eth_refill.py, 24 tests) rather than appended to the already-large test_franklin_sol_base_refill.py; pure-function gas tests are appended to the existing test_refill_plan.py (appropriate, since is_valid_evm_address/evaluate_native_delivery live in the same refill_plan.py module). Total new-test count independently verified by grep-counting '^def test_' across both files: 24 + 24 = 48, matching the claimed figure exactly.

Purity re-confirmed: is_valid_evm_address and evaluate_native_delivery both take only their explicit arguments, perform no I/O/network/clock reads, and evaluate_native_delivery is a dataclass-returning pure function matching the purity-boundary claim in verification-architecture.md's Changelog. No I/O import (requests/urllib/subprocess/time) anywhere in refill_plan.py.

eth_get_balance mirrors the already-reviewed erc20_balance_units/eth_get_transaction_receipt contract exactly (raises on RPC/network failure rather than silently returning 0, same User-Agent header, same raw-hex-to-int parsing) -- structurally consistent with the existing PASS-reviewed precedent in the same file, even though (like its precedent) it has no dedicated unit test of its own (I/O function, mocked only at the orchestration-test deps boundary, consistent with existing convention).

FIND-002 (the expected_wei<=0 floor-bypass in evaluate_native_delivery) should also be fixed first, since it is a genuine fail-open path in the exact function this real money move depends on for independent delivery proof, even though it requires a degenerate relay response to trigger.
